description: This source file defines the ProductsController class, which is an ASP.NET Core Web API controller responsible for handling CRUD operations related to products. It includes endpoints for retrieving all products, retrieving a product by ID, creating, updating, and deleting products. The class interacts with a product repository and uses dependency injection, and it exposes a RESTful API interface with JSON responses.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core API controller managing product resources with endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all products asynchronously and returns them as a JSON array.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a single product by ID, returning 404 if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new product based on provided data and returns the created product with its ID.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing product, identified by ID, with new data.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, returning appropriate status based on success.
